en: \bThe league is over. Come back next year.

id: \bThis is my third time trying. No way am I losing.
en: \bThis is my third time trying. No way am I losing.

id: \rI came to cheer on Alain. He's a good friend of mine.
en: \rI came to cheer on Alain. He's a good friend of mine.
it: \rSono venuta a fare il tifo per Alain. È un mio caro amico.

en: \bSawyer: This is going to be so much fun. I can't wait to see what I learn.
it: \bSawyer: Sarà divertentissimo. Non vedo l'ora di scoprire cosa imparerò.

id: \bSawyer: Looks like I'm fighting you next. It's a shame we both can't win. I won't hold back though.
en: \bSawyer: Looks like I'm fighting you next. It's a shame we both can't win. I won't hold back though.
it: \bSawyer: Sembra che il mio prossimo avversario sia tu. Peccato che non possiamo vincere entrambi. Ma non mi tratterrò.

id: \bDon't feel bad. There is always next year.
en: \bDon't feel bad. There is always next year.
it: \bNon abbatterti. C'è sempre l'anno prossimo.

id: \rHello. Here you can register for the Lumiose Conference.
en: \rHello. Here you can register for the Lumiose Conference.
it: \rSalve. Qui puoi iscriverti alla Conferenza di Luminopoli.

en: \rYour first battle will be to the far left. Good luck!

en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.

en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.

en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rThank you for waiting.
en: \rThank you for waiting.

en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
